_not_minted_deliberately._comment: Prototype strings this slice DROPPED rather than keyed. Each is a CLAIM, not a missing value, and a claim cannot be em-dashed the way a value can. BLOCKERS.md B-297 files them.
_not_minted_deliberately.fmAcceptDoneBanner: mobile-field.jsx L173 '✓ ตรวจแล้ว · ส่งผลเข้าระบบ' — set by a LOCAL boolean (setDone, L150/L176) while nothing was sent. The port proves a successful inspection by RE-READING the acceptance queue instead.
_not_minted_deliberately.fieldProgressCta: mobile-screens.jsx L353 'ขออนุมัติงวด · 645,000 ฿' — the amount is hardcoded and money = SERVER. The button is labelled with wo.form.deliverWork, which names what it actually does.
_not_minted_deliberately.fieldProgressPercent: mobile-screens.jsx L331/L334 '78%' / 'เดิม 65%' / '+13 ppt วันนี้' — a work period carries a STATUS, not a completion percentage, and none may be derived from a count of delivered periods (the bases make periods unequal by construction).
_not_minted_deliberately.fieldPrEstimate: mobile-screens.jsx L447 'ราคาประมาณ 82,000 ฿' — qty x price is client money math.
_not_minted_deliberately.fieldPrCta: mobile-screens.jsx L473 'ส่ง PR ด่วน · 82,000 ฿' — same reason; the PR's value is rendered only after POST /pr returns it.
_not_minted_deliberately.fieldPrApprovalChain: mobile-screens.jsx L467 'ส่ง → หน.จัดซื้อ → ผจก.โครงการ → ผอ.ก่อสร้าง (วงเงิน ≥ 100K)' — the implemented tiers are 500,000 / 2,000,000 (apps/api/src/routes/pr.ts, B-070), so this text states something FALSE about the requester's own document.
